title: NeuroMotion: Aligning EEG to Discrete Motion Primitives for Continuous Motion Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30817v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: EEG-to-motion decoding remains challenging because noisy scalp EEG is difficult to map directly to continuous kinematics. We present NeuroMotion, a framework that aligns EEG representations to discrete motion primitives for continuous motion decoding across heterogeneous paradigms, including full-body free movement, lower-limb treadmill locomotion, and upper-limb freewill reaching and grasping. A VQ-based motion prior discretizes continuous motion into reusable primitives that serve as both alignment prototypes and intermediate prediction targets. Prototypical and supervised contrastive objectives align EEG embeddings to motion-derived prototypes and organize them according to primitive assignments. An E2M Transformer predicts motion-code sequences from the learned EEG representations, while a final geometric refinement stage improves continuous trajectory reconstruction through motion-level training. translated_title: NeuroMotion：将脑电对齐到离散运动基元以实现连续运动解码
translated_abstract: 脑电（EEG）到运动的解码仍然具有挑战性，因为嘈杂的头皮脑电信号难以直接映射到连续的运动学参数。我们提出了NeuroMotion，这是一个将脑电表征对齐到离散运动基元的框架，可在多种异构范式下实现连续运动解码，包括全身自由运动、下肢跑台行走以及上肢自主伸手与抓握。基于向量量化（VQ）的运动先验将连续运动离散化为可复用的基元，这些基元既作为对齐原型，也作为中间预测目标。原型对比与有监督对比目标将脑电嵌入对齐到由运动导出的原型，并根据基元分配对它们进行组织。一个E2M Transformer从学习到的脑电表征中预测运动码序列，而最后的几何精化阶段则通过运动级训练改进连续轨迹的重建。在最后一次会话的测试协议下，
tldr: 该论文提出NeuroMotion框架，通过VQ将连续运动离散化为可复用的运动基元，并把脑电表征对齐到这些基元原型，从而在全身运动、下肢行走、上肢抓握等多种异构范式下实现连续运动解码。
en_tdlr: NeuroMotion aligns EEG representations to VQ-discretized motion primitives, enabling continuous motion decoding across heterogeneous paradigms including full-body free movement, lower-limb locomotion, and upper-limb reaching and grasping.
